tips: OMR sheet par WHITENER/ERASER BILKUL NAHI USE KARNA — yeh disqualification ka reason ban sakta hai.
Part B Q2 mein 6 parts diye hain, attempt karo KISI BHI 5 — always skip the one hardest for you.
Q3-Q5 mein OR option hai — reading time mein hi decide karo kaunsa attempt karna hai.
Geometry proofs mein REASON likhna COMPULSORY hai — [Given], [By AA similarity], [CPCT], [By BPT] etc.
Heights & distances mein pehle diagram banao, angles label karo — 1 mark diagram ka milega even if solution incomplete.
Statistics mein median ke liye cumulative frequency table ZAROOR banao — without it marks nahi milte.
Mensuration mein pi = 22/7 use karo jab tak kuch aur na diya gaya ho.
AP sum problem: pehle common difference find karo, phir formula lagao.
Irrational number proof: contradiction method use karo. Assume rational, get contradiction, conclude irrational.
Quadratic equation word problems: dono values of x check karo — ek negative nahi ho sakta (e.g., length/speed).
Probability: sample space clearly likho, then count favourable outcomes carefully.

time_allocation.note: Pehle Part A ke 20 MCQ padho mentally. Part B mein Q3, Q4, Q5 ke OR choices tay karo. Jo nahi aata usko skip karoge — decide karo.
20 MCQ × 1.5 min. OMR carefully fill karo — whitener not allowed. Jo pakka pata ho pehle karo, doubtful baad mein.
6 parts × 4 min. Sabhi compulsory. Concise answers. Show working. Proof: 2-3 logical steps.
6 parts given, attempt 5. Read all 6, choose easiest 5. Proofs + numericals. ~9 min each.
3 questions × 20 min each (including OR choice selection). Diagram first, then solution.
Check: Unit in mensuration answers. Reason written in proofs. OMR filled correctly.

targets.strategy: Part A (14-16/20) + Part B Q1 all 6 parts (12) + Part B Q2 any 3 easy parts (12) = 38-40 marks.
focus_areas: Part A: All MCQ topics prepared — trig values, statistics (mode/median class), AP, probability

targets.strategy: Part A (17-18) + Part B Q1 full (12) + Part B Q2 full 5 parts (20) + Part B Q3-Q4 (6+6) = 61-62 marks.
focus_areas: All proofs: BPT, Pythagoras, tangent equal, trigonometric identities

targets.strategy: All sections full marks. Part A 20/20, Part B Q1 12/12, Q2 all 5 best (20/20), Q3+Q4+Q5 all 18/18 = 70/70.

Q3-Q5 OR choices: Know both options in reading time, choose simpler one
Geometrical figures: neat and properly labeled — 1 mark for figure even if proof incomplete

books.note: Chapterwise MCQ, 2-mark, 4-mark, 6-mark questions + 20 Most Important Questions + previous year papers 2020-2025 + 5 model papers. Based on NEP 2020, latest 2025-26 syllabus.

books.name: Previous Year Board Papers 2020-2025
books.note: Multiple sets per year. Solving 2-3 years papers is the best exam preparation. Pattern recognition helps choose correct Q2 parts and Q3-Q5 OR options.

books.name: UP Board Model Papers 2026
books.note: Available on upmsp.edu.in. Practice at least 2 model papers under timed conditions before exam.

answer_sheet_rules: question_number_compulsory: True
question_number_note: Har answer ke upar question number clearly likhna zaroori hai.
set_number_compulsory: True
set_number_note: Apna set number (822 BV/BW etc.) answer sheet ke cover page par compulsory likhna hota hai.
omr_rules: OMR sheet mein: ek baar mark kiya toh change nahi kar sakte. Erase, cut, whitener bilkul not allowed. Carefully mark karo.
rough_work: Rough work answer book ke LEFT page par karo aur us page ko X se cross kar do. Left page pe rough work, right page pe fair answer.
question_copy_compulsory: False
question_copy_note: Answer sheet mein question likhna zaroori nahi. Sirf question number likho aur answer shuru karo.
sequence_compulsory: True
sequence_note: Instructions say: Q1 se shuru karo aur last tak jao. Jo nahi aata usse skip karo aur aage badho — lekin sequence follow karna better hai.
sub_questions: Q1 ke parts (a), (b), (c)... clearly likhkaro. Q2 mein jo 5 parts attempt karo unke letter clearly likho.
partial_marking: True
partial_marking_note: Mathematics mein partial marking hoti hai. Correct method/formula but calculation mistake — phir bhi 2/3 ya 3/4 marks milenge.
steps_marking: True
steps_marking_note: Proofs aur numericals mein step-by-step marking hoti hai.
reason_in_proof_marks: Geometry proof mein reason nahi likha toh each step se 0.5 mark cut ho sakta hai.
calculation_compulsory: True
calculation_note: Calculation steps dikhao. Sirf final answer likhne se full marks nahi milenge.
correct_answer_wrong_steps: Final answer sahi lekin steps galat — marks cut hote hain.
wrong_units: Unit nahi likhi ya galat likhi — marks cut ho sakte hain.
omr_marking: MCQ mein OMR par option bubble clearly fill karo. Half filled or lightly filled bubbles rejected ho sakte hain.
no_attempt_marks: Koi bhi part attempt nahi kiya toh zero marks.

pen_rules.note: allowed_colors: ['Blue', 'Black'] both_colors_together: True single_color_ok: True pencil_use: Sirf geometrical figures/constructions aur rough work ke liye pencil allowed hai. Answers kabhi pencil se mat likho. pen_diagram: Pen se diagram banana allowed hai. Pencil se banana zyaada neat hota hai — recommended. recommendation: Blue pen se main answer, black se headings/underline. Ya sirf ek color bhi chalega. omr_pen: OMR sheet par blue ya black BALL POINT pen se mark karo. Gel pen se bhi allowed hai lekin ensure karo nib thick ho.

exam_writing_rules.diagram_rules: word_limit_excess: Mathematics mein word limit nahi hoti. Steps clearly likhni hain. Unnecessary long theory mat likho. step_numbering: Proofs mein statements numbered karo. Reasons bracket mein likhna required hai — e.g. [By BPT]. reason_compulsory_in_proofs: True reason_note: Geometry proofs mein har step ke saath reason COMPULSORY hai — [Given], [by SAS], [By BPT], [CPCT] etc. Reason nahi likha toh marks cut hote hain. final_answer_box: Numericals mein final answer box karna recommended. Examiner ka dhyan aata hai. given_required_to_prove: Geometry proofs mein 'Given:', 'To Prove:', 'Construction:', 'Proof:' — yeh headings likhna recommended hai. hence_proved: Proof ke end mein 'Hence Proved' ya 'QED' likhna good practice hai. table_for_statistics: Statistics mein cumulative frequency table banana COMPULSORY hai for median. Tabular format use karo. figure_in_geometry: Geometry proofs mein figure banana practically compulsory hai — 1 mark alag figure ke liye hota hai. units_compulsory: Mensuration mein final answer ke saath unit (cm, cm², cm³) likhna zaroori hai.
